description: Independent verification of structural properties of Lucas rungs in Fibonacci address space and nonce-estate coverage.

zeckendorf_atomicity.note: Every tested L_n decomposes to a single Zeckendorf term (L_n = F_{n-1} + F_{n+1}).

coverage_parity.note: Odd L_n partition a power-of-two estate exactly (gcd=1). Even L_n yield gcd=2 and cover only half the estate.
coverage_parity.reason: L_20 and L_50 are even; reduced mod 2^k the gcd is 2.

throughput_in_tested_scheme.note: Indexing a fixed estate by L_n lanes increased total iterations in the construction tested. The estate must be sized to the rung, or a different indexing used, before a throughput claim can be made.
